lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso with relatively uniform spacing, though density increases slightly toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A vertical line in the mid-torso region (approximately 60% posterior from the shoulder) shows a Y-shaped bifurcation near the dorsal ridge where two lines merge into one.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 3 most posterior lines are fragmented into dashed segments and do not maintain continuity from the dorsal ridge to the ventral area.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3-4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, situated approximately halfway between the tail base and the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper hind limb are aligned horizontally, creating a short semi-linear geometric marker.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a posterior-dorsal trajectory with a slight inward lyrate curvature at the terminal ends; the left horn (viewer perspective) shows a sharper vertical angle.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single horn base in this 2D perspective.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately the distal 10-15% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron between the eyes, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek, and prominent white 'socks' starting above the hooves on the forelimbs.
